attempts.text:
This plan rescues 12 people and defers 6, for a total cost of 476.

**Road access**
- **Unusable roads:** Kispang–Thakre and Tadi–Galchhi are flooded, and Gosaikunda–Dupcheshwar is buried by a landslide.
- **Cut-off locations:** Tadi market and Naukunda farm connect only to each other and the flooded Tadi–Galchhi road, so no car can reach them.
- **Drop-off point:** Kispang shelter is the only designated evacuation point. Galchhi temple is not, so people can't be dropped there.

**Decisions by location**

| Location | People | Decision | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Myagang temple | 3 injured, 2 elderly, 3 adults | Rescue in 2 trips of 32 minutes each | 64 |
| Galchhi temple | 4 children | Rescue in 1 trip of 82 minutes, which beats the 240 penalty | 82 |
| Dupcheshwar temple | 1 elderly | Defer, as the 50 penalty is just below the 52-minute round trip | 50 |
| Tadi market | 3 injured | Defer because it is unreachable (3 × 80) | 240 |
| Naukunda farm | 2 adults | Defer because it is unreachable (2 × 20) | 40 |

<plan>
drive car1 kispang-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 injured 3
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 myagang-temple kispang-shelter
unload car1 injured 3
unload car1 elderly 1
drive car1 kispang-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 elderly 1
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 myagang-temple kispang-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
unload car1 adult 3
drive car2 kispang-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car2 gosaikunda-temple galchhi-temple
load car2 child 4
drive car2 galchhi-temple gosaikunda-temple
drive car2 gosaikunda-temple kispang-shelter
unload car2 child 4
defer dupcheshwar-temple elderly 1
defer tadi-market injured 3
defer naukunda-farm adult 2
</plan>

**Cost breakdown:** Driving is 146 minutes (64 + 82) and deferral penalties are 330 (50 + 240 + 40).

**Priorities for the next wave**
- **Tadi market:** The three injured residents can't be reached until the Tadi–Galchhi road is passable, so they should be the first priority.
- **Dupcheshwar temple:** The old man who can't walk unaided is deferred by a margin of only 2 points, even though his road is clear. A coordinator could reasonably send a car anyway, which would raise the total cost to 478.

COST: 476
